title: Enhancing Accessibility of Medical Texts through Large Language Model-Driven Plain Language Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2609.17398v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper addresses the challenge of making complex healthcare information more accessible through automated Plain Language Adaptation (PLA). PLA aims to simplify technical medical language, bridging a critical gap between the complexity of healthcare texts and patients' reading comprehension. Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs), such as GPT and BART, have opened new possibilities for PLA, especially in zero-shot and few-shot learning contexts where task-specific data is limited. In this work, we leverage the capabilities of LLMs such as GPT-4o-mini, Gemini-1.5-pro, and LLaMA for text simplification. Additionally, we incorporate Mixture-of-Agents (MoA) techniques to enhance adaptability and robustness in PLA tasks. Key contributions include a comparative analysis of prompting strategies, finetuning with QLoRA on different LLMs, and the integration of MoA technique. Our findings demonstrate the effectiveness of LLM-driven PLA

translated_title: 通过大语言模型驱动的通俗语言改写提升医学文本的可及性
translated_abstract: 本文探讨了通过自动化的通俗语言改写使复杂医疗信息更易于获取的挑战。通俗语言改写旨在简化专业医学语言，弥合医疗文本复杂性与患者阅读理解能力之间的关键差距。GPT和BART等大语言模型的最新进展为通俗语言改写开辟了新的可能性，尤其是在任务特定数据有限的零样本和少样本学习场景中。在本工作中，我们利用GPT-4o-mini、Gemini-1.5-pro和LLaMA等大语言模型的能力进行文本简化。此外，我们引入了混合代理技术，以增强通俗语言改写任务的适应性和鲁棒性。主要贡献包括提示策略的对比分析、使用QLoRA对不同大语言模型进行微调，以及混合代理技术的集成。我们的研究结果证明了大语言模型驱动的通俗语言改写的有效性。
tldr: 本文利用GPT-4o-mini、Gemini-1.5-pro、LLaMA等大语言模型，结合提示策略对比分析、QLoRA微调以及混合代理（MoA）技术，实现医学文本的自动化通俗语言改写，有效提升医疗信息的可及性。
en_tdlr: This paper leverages LLMs such as GPT-4o-mini, Gemini-1.5-pro, and LLaMA, combining comparative analysis of prompting strategies, QLoRA finetuning, and Mixture-of-Agents techniques to achieve automated Plain Language Adaptation of medical texts, effectively enhancing healthcare information accessibility.
